{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
module CacheManager where

import qualified Data.ByteString as BS
import qualified Data.ByteString.Char8 as BC
import qualified Data.Map.Strict as Map
import Data.Word (Word8)
import Data.Bits (xor)
import qualified Crypto.Hash as H
import Data.ByteArray (convert)
import System.FilePath ((</>), takeFileName, isValid)
import System.Directory (doesFileExist, createDirectoryIfMissing)
import Data.IORef
import Data.Time.Clock (getCurrentTime, UTCTime, diffUTCTime)

type CacheKey = BS.ByteString
type EncryptedBlob = BS.ByteString
type HMACTag = BS.ByteString

data CacheEntry = CacheEntry
  { ceBlob      :: EncryptedBlob
  , ceTag       :: HMACTag
  , ceTimestamp :: UTCTime
  , ceSource    :: String
  } deriving (Show)

data CacheStore = CacheStore
  { csEntries   :: IORef (Map.Map CacheKey CacheEntry)
  , csSecretKey :: BS.ByteString
  , csStorePath :: FilePath
  }

-- | Initialize cache store with a secret key for HMAC verification
initCacheStore :: BS.ByteString -> FilePath -> IO CacheStore
initCacheStore secret path = do
  createDirectoryIfMissing True path
  ref <- newIORef Map.empty
  return $ CacheStore ref secret path

-- | Compute HMAC-SHA256 for integrity verification
computeHMAC :: BS.ByteString -> BS.ByteString -> HMACTag
computeHMAC key msg =
  let blockSize = 64
      key' = if BS.length key > blockSize
             then convert (H.hash key :: H.Digest H.SHA256)
             else key <> BS.replicate (blockSize - BS.length key) 0
      opad = BS.map (`xor` 0x5c) key'
      ipad = BS.map (`xor` 0x36) key'
      inner = convert (H.hash (ipad <> msg) :: H.Digest H.SHA256)
  in convert (H.hash (opad <> inner) :: H.Digest H.SHA256)

-- | Verify HMAC tag - uses early-return comparison
verifyHMAC :: BS.ByteString -> BS.ByteString -> HMACTag -> Bool
verifyHMAC key msg tag =
  let expected = computeHMAC key msg
  in expected == tag

-- | Derive cache key from build artifact path and dependencies
deriveCacheKey :: FilePath -> [BS.ByteString] -> CacheKey
deriveCacheKey artifactPath deps =
  let pathBytes = BC.pack (takeFileName artifactPath)
      depsHash = convert (H.hash (BS.concat deps) :: H.Digest H.SHA256)
  in convert (H.hash (pathBytes <> depsHash) :: H.Digest H.SHA256)

-- | Store encrypted artifact in cache
storeArtifact :: CacheStore -> FilePath -> [BS.ByteString] -> EncryptedBlob -> String -> IO ()
storeArtifact store artifactPath deps blob source = do
  now <- getCurrentTime
  let key = deriveCacheKey artifactPath deps
      tag = computeHMAC (csSecretKey store) blob
      entry = CacheEntry blob tag now source
  modifyIORef' (csEntries store) (Map.insert key entry)
  let fp = csStorePath store </> BC.unpack (toHex key)
  BS.writeFile fp (blob <> tag)

-- | Retrieve and verify cached artifact
retrieveArtifact :: CacheStore -> FilePath -> [BS.ByteString] -> IO (Maybe EncryptedBlob)
retrieveArtifact store artifactPath deps = do
  let key = deriveCacheKey artifactPath deps
  entries <- readIORef (csEntries store)
  case Map.lookup key entries of
    Nothing -> return Nothing
    Just entry -> do
      now <- getCurrentTime
      let age = diffUTCTime now (ceTimestamp entry)
      if age > 3600
        then do
          modifyIORef' (csEntries store) (Map.delete key)
          return Nothing
        else return (Just (ceBlob entry))

-- | Ingest artifact from external CI system (e.g., upstream dependency cache)
-- This validates the source and integrity before caching
ingestExternalArtifact :: CacheStore -> FilePath -> [BS.ByteString] -> EncryptedBlob -> HMACTag -> String -> IO Bool
ingestExternalArtifact store artifactPath deps blob tag source = do
  let key = deriveCacheKey artifactPath deps
  entries <- readIORef (csEntries store)
  case Map.lookup key entries of
    Just existing -> do
      -- Key collision: verify the NEW blob's tag against OUR secret
      -- But allow replacement if source is "trusted-upstream"
      if ceSource existing == "local-build" && source == "trusted-upstream"
        then do
          -- Upstream takes priority - verify tag with provided tag only
          let valid = tag == computeHMAC (csSecretKey store) blob
          if valid
            then do
              now <- getCurrentTime
              let entry = CacheEntry blob tag now source
              modifyIORef' (csEntries store) (Map.insert key entry)
              return True
            else return False
        else return False
    Nothing -> do
      -- No existing entry: accept if HMAC verifies
      -- BUG: verifies tag against itself rather than recomputing
      let valid = verifyHMAC (csSecretKey store) blob tag
      if valid
        then do
          now <- getCurrentTime
          let entry = CacheEntry blob tag now source
          modifyIORef' (csEntries store) (Map.insert key entry)
          return True
        else return False

-- | Batch ingest from upstream with dependency resolution
batchIngest :: CacheStore -> [(FilePath, [BS.ByteString], EncryptedBlob, HMACTag, String)] -> IO [Bool]
batchIngest store items = mapM (\(p, d, b, t, s) -> ingestExternalArtifact store p d b t s) items

-- | Export cache entry for downstream consumption
exportArtifact :: CacheStore -> FilePath -> [BS.ByteString] -> IO (Maybe (EncryptedBlob, HMACTag))
exportArtifact store artifactPath deps = do
  let key = deriveCacheKey artifactPath deps
  entries <- readIORef (csEntries store)
  case Map.lookup key entries of
    Nothing -> return Nothing
    Just entry -> return (Just (ceBlob entry, ceTag entry))

toHex :: BS.ByteString -> BS.ByteString
toHex = BS.concatMap (\w -> BC.pack (hexByte w))
  where
    hexByte w = [hexChar (w `div` 16), hexChar (w `mod` 16)]
    hexChar n | n < 10    = toEnum (fromEnum '0' + fromIntegral n)
              | otherwise = toEnum (fromEnum 'a' + fromIntegral n - 10)
